title: Fukuyama sister city delegation and follow-up
summary: The Council announced and then held a special meeting welcoming a Fukuyama City Assembly delegation, noting a 2008 resolution made Fukuyama a sister city, and the guests asked about water, power and federal aid for the Lahaina rebuild. The vice chair agreed to discuss the sister city topic further in the vice chair's committee.

timeline.text: A speaker said the federal government gave 1.6 billion dollars for housing and rebuilding.
A guest asked who is in charge of water and power as Lahaina recovers.
The chair said a resolution adopted on February 11, 2008, made Fukuyama City a sister city of Maui County.
The Maui County Council held a special meeting to welcome members of the Fukuyama City Assembly.
The vice chair agreed to discuss the sister city topic further in the vice chair's committee.
The meet-and-greet is set for 4 to 5 p.m.
Staff asked the chair to announce that a delegation from the Fukuyama City Council will visit for a meet-and-greet in the council chamber.
